silicon_structure_retrieval_subtask_sa.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Surface Area
silicon_structure_retrieval_subtask_sa.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_potential_file_subtask_sa.name: Silicon Potential File for Surface Energy
silicon_potential_file_subtask_sa.description: Procure an appropriate ReaxFF potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.name: Silicon bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Silicon based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"BULK ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": /structure/structure.data}

silicon_slab_energy_minimisation_subtask.name: Silicon Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy
silicon_slab_energy_minimisation_subtask.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation of the slab based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
silicon_slab_energy_minimisation_subtask.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"SLAB ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": /structure/structure.dat}

silicon_subtask_sa.name: Silicon Surface Energy Calculation
silicon_subtask_sa.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of Silicon, and the total energies (in kcal/mol) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of Silicon. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²).
